tagline: AI agents that join scattered hospital data, explain why patient flow is stuck, and check every claim before an operator sees it.

meterless_engines.implementation: Own Python implementation following the engine's pattern (not the TypeScript reference package).
meterless_engines.used_for: Shared state that every agent reads and writes: hospital entities (beds, patients, staff, units, ambulances, locations) with stable ids, per-source values with timestamps (provenance), and relations.

where_used.how: ingest_live() and ingest_reference() load both sources through Zetaris into the model
issues.py finds bottlenecks by joining entities and relations in the model
receives its evidence as a compact view of the model (context())
verifies every cited entity, attribute and value against the model in code

meterless_engines.implementation: Own Python implementation following the engine's tiers (not the TypeScript reference package); memory is plain files on disk under memory/.
meterless_engines.used_for: Gives the agents a sense of time the live feed lacks: when each problem and patient status was first seen, which problems cleared and after how long, and lessons from repeated problems.

tiers.working: memory/working.json: open issues and tracked patient statuses with first-seen times
tiers.episodic: memory/episodic.jsonl: every investigation and every resolved issue with its duration
tiers.semantic: memory/semantic.json: lessons consolidated from repeated episodes
tiers.ledger: memory/ledger.jsonl: every memory write with its reason

meterless_engines.conflict_resolution: A newer live observation replaces an older one; the ledger records what was replaced and why. An issue must be absent for 3 minutes before it counts as resolved.

where_used.feature: Every agent run and the watch mode
where_used.how: observe() updates working memory and records resolved episodes
recall() adds how long the problem and each patient status have lasted, past resolutions and lessons
record_investigation() and consolidate() write episodic and semantic memory
shows how long each problem has been open and what the Copilot remembers

zetaris.role: Data layer: one SQL interface over a live hospital REST API and a Snowflake warehouse, with no copying. Every read in the project goes through Zetaris.

sources.api: live hospital feed: patients, beds, cleaning tasks, transport requests, staff locations, ambulances
sources.riverside: Snowflake warehouse, used for reference data: unit capacities, staff roster and shifts, ambulance crews, floors, locations

nvidia.role: Reasoning model for the Investigator, Critic and Explainer agents.

ai_coding_tools.cursor: Cursor's agent built world_model.py and its first tests (screenshots in the submission).
ai_coding_tools.other: Later work was written with Claude.

agents.name: Collector
agents.role: Loads fresh data from both sources into the World Model

agents.name: Monitor
agents.role: Finds and ranks problems, each with its evidence

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Explains the cause with cited evidence (NVIDIA Nemotron)

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Checks every claim in code and with Nemotron; sends weak drafts back, up to 4 rounds

agents.name: Explainer
agents.role: Writes the operator message, or marks the answer unverified

evidence_for_judges.traces: logs/run_*.jsonl (every agent step) and logs/answer_run_*.json (each full answer)
evidence_for_judges.api_docs: http://localhost:8100/docs when the API is running

integration.live_ops_panel: integrations/liveops-panel/useCopilot.tsx and copilot.css, added to the Live Ops map page
integration.route: Live Ops nginx passes /copilot/ to the Copilot API, keeping the page's connect-src 'self' policy unchanged

pre_existing_components: Live Ops 3D operations map, including its rule-based Ask, sensor Watch, optional LLM rephrasing and on-site connector
The Zetaris instance and its source connections
The Snowflake warehouse and its simulator
built_during_hackathon: Everything in this repository, plus the Live Ops Copilot panel, its hook-up in the Live Ops map page and the /copilot/ nginx route. Work started 22 October 2026.
data: Simulated hospital data; no real patients.
